title: Dorm university student (no job, 6 classes, 19 credits, Moodle, afternoon steady) learns her online Physics final moved to Thu Dec 10, 2 to 4 PM, the middle of her firm study window; Dev plans review blocks before it and never books study over the exam itself.

changes.title: Physics final exam moved to Thursday Dec 10, 2 to 4 PM
changes.announcement: Because of a room change for the online proctoring pool, the Physics I final exam is now Thursday Dec 10, 2:00 to 4:00 PM, instead of Friday Dec 18. Same format, same length.

dev_must_notice.what: The Physics final moved from Dec 18 to Thursday Dec 10, 2:00 to 4:00 PM (c-final.announcement, exam-phys-406-final-exam, posted today 4:10 PM). That is exactly her firm Thursday afternoon study window (14:00 to 16:45, m-01), so the usual study slot that day is the exam. Her other classes are Spanish and Econ that morning, and her Econ and Spanish finals come later.

best_fix.what: Offer two Physics review blocks in her afternoon window, Monday Dec 7 and Wednesday Dec 9, 2:00 to 4:00 PM, as one tap that adds them with Undo, and leave Thursday Dec 10 afternoon empty for the exam (a short note: nothing is booked on exam day).
best_fix.why: Her study is afternoons (m-01); the exam now replaces Thursday's slot, so the review moves to the two nearest afternoons before it. Monday and Wednesday are free after her 12:00 Biology class ends at 12:50.

tempting.suggestion: keep the usual Thursday Dec 10 afternoon study block, or book a review block at 2 PM on exam day
tempting.why_wrong: Thursday 2 to 4 PM is the exam itself; a study block there double-books her

must_not: book or keep a study block over the exam time on Thursday Dec 10 (2 to 4 PM)
keep the old Dec 18 date in any plan or reminder
put study in the evening or after 6:30 PM (she studies afternoons)
write, solve or check anything for the exam (planning only)
tell her to ask the professor to move it back
